audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Syndra/Skill/Syndra while the content layer read Brand/Brand/Syndra/Syndra/Brand/Syndra/Brand — all seven rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly (Brand, Brand, Syndra, Syndra, Brand, Syndra, Brand), and 49.85% over 682 games fits a lane that changes hands rather than one that is skill-matchup flat.
audit.corrected: Moved every phases[N].side onto the content/packet verdict and rewrote phases[2].why, phases[3].why and phases[5].why so the sentence under each Syndra row describes Syndra winning it.

audit.why: Her spikes are sphere accumulation at 3-5 (Dark Sphere is a flat 7s at every rank), Unleashed Power at 6 (120/100/80s, 675 range, executes with Transcendent), and her Splinters of Wrath upgrades. Brand's are level 3 E-Q, Pyroclasm at 6 (100s), and Liandry's.
audit.corrected: Kept the spike structure; folded the 120s rank-1 R cooldown and the 7s Q into the cooldown field so the spikes are playable numbers rather than adjectives.
sources: enemyKit Q cd 7, R cd 120/100/80 range 675

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Syndra's damage partly bypasses resistances, and breakdown.cooldowns carried no cooldown at all.
audit.why: Transcendent upgrades Force of Will to deal bonus true damage, so stacking MR is not the answer to her poke. Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at 650 range — longer than Brand's 625-range E and his 8s Q — so her stun window, not his, sets the tempo. Brand's Q only stuns an ablaze target, so E must land first.
audit.corrected: Named the 15s E, the 7s Dark Sphere and the 120s R in breakdown.cooldowns, and put the true-damage warning into breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fourteen fields called Syndra 'he/his', and two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender lists syndra as female; the lint flagged each field deterministically.
audit.corrected: Every flagged pronoun corrected, and both bleed bullets rewritten to match their own titles.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E-Q stun package has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak is a flat 15s at every rank, 650 range — that is your whole window, so step up the second she spends it. - Dark Sphere is 7s, faster than your 8s Q, so never trade cast-for-cast. - Unleashed Power is 120s at rank 1. - Your own R is 100s: it closes fights, it does not open them.

notes: Full-layer sides disagreed with content win[N] on all seven rows; content matched packet.levelChart exactly, so the full layer was moved onto it and the three whys that then contradicted their row were rewritten. No win[N] edits were needed — the content layer was already correct. phases[N].rating was left alone: in this data set the rating tracks stage intensity, not who owns the row (the Sylas page rates Brand-winning rows 7-8/10 while this page rates a Syndra row 7/10), so flipping ratings would have been guesswork. suspectNames flagged wants.foe[2] 'Use Unleashed Power' — that is Syndra's real R name and a false positive; no edit made. Five report[] entries were touched, above the usual two-entry cap, but each is a lint-flagged single-pronoun correction rather than a rewrite.
